BOILERPLATE

Three lengths.
Quote any of them as written.

Each paragraph is built from facts published on the homepage, the software thesis, the security posture and the AI Training Centre page. Quote verbatim or cut from the end.

50 words

VF Empire Corp Ltd is a systems engineering house in Malta, EU. It designs the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls, builds its own line of local-first software, and operates an AI Training Centre. Founded in 2019.

100 words

VF Empire Corp Ltd is a systems engineering house in Malta, EU. It designs the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls, builds its own line of local-first software, and operates an AI Training Centre. Founded in 2019 in Għajnsielem, Gozo, VF builds every system local-first: models, data and controls run on machines the owner holds, with the cloud optional. The Helmsman engine routes work across models, gates every output against evidence and self-heals failures. Twenty-two systems are on the build slate; every product carries the Permanence Guarantee.

200 words

VF Empire Corp Ltd is a systems engineering house in Malta, EU. It designs the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls, builds its own line of local-first software, and operates an AI Training Centre. Founded in 2019 in Għajnsielem, Gozo, VF builds every system local-first: models, data and controls run on machines the owner holds, with the cloud optional. The Helmsman engine routes work across models, gates every output against evidence and self-heals failures. Twenty-two systems are on the build slate; every product carries the Permanence Guarantee. Three fixed-fee services bring the same method to EU manufacturers under the Cyber Resilience Act and GDPR. Public repositories are scanned for secrets on every push, releases are signed by two operators in separate EU jurisdictions, builds are reproducible from public source, and a paid bug bounty runs from €500 to €25 000, tiered by severity. The VF AI Training Centre teaches open-model fitting, harness engineering, dashboard and control design and utilisation labs; its first intake is forming. VF Empire is registered in Malta (C 94160), with network companies Noirda GmbH in Germany and Guardian Network in the United Kingdom.

QUESTIONS

Asked.
Answered.

How do I get the VF Empire press kit?

Write to press@vfempire.com. The desk sends the kit and the founder bio at once, and a person replies to anything else within 1 business day. The kit carries the mark as files and the facts on this page. This site loads no third-party script or font, so there is nothing to download here beyond what you can read.

Who can I interview at VF Empire?

Vincent Falzon, founder and Managing Director. Interview requests sent to press@vfempire.com reach him the same day, and the desk confirms within 1 business day. He speaks to the method (engines, harnesses, dashboards), the build slate, the security posture and the AI Training Centre. Written questions are welcome as well.

What is VF Empire in one sentence?

VF Empire is a systems engineering house in Malta that designs the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls. The 50-word boilerplate above adds the product line, the training centre and the founding year; the longer versions add the services and the security posture.

Can I use the VF Empire logo in an article?

Ask press@vfempire.com for the files and state the use. The mark, the wordmarks (VF EMPIRE, S◉LOCK, Helmsman) and the site imagery belong to VF Empire Corp Ltd under section 7 of the Terms of Service, which permits viewing and printing for internal reference and requires written consent for other reproduction. The desk answers within 1 business day.

Where is VF Empire based and where does it work?

VF Empire Corp Ltd is registered in Malta (C 94160) with its office in Għajnsielem on Gozo. It serves Malta, the EU, Germany and the United Kingdom in English, German and Maltese, with network companies Noirda GmbH in Germany and Guardian Network in the UK. Every system ships to hardware the client holds, wherever that is.
